question: When did the member, Casey Mason, received the income?

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "member_incomes" AS SELECT
  i.income_id,
  m.member_id,
  m.first_name,
  m.last_name,
  i.amount,
  i.source,
  i.notes,
  i.year,
  i.month,
  i.day
FROM table_1 AS i
JOIN table_2 AS m
  ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT
  make_date(CAST(year AS INTEGER), CAST(month AS INTEGER), CAST(day AS INTEGER)) AS received_date
FROM member_incomes
WHERE lower(first_name) = 'casey' AND lower(last_name) = 'mason'
GROUP BY received_date
ORDER BY received_date
